messages:
sam: Heads-up: NimbusEdge says three POs are getting rejected by the marketplace because their new catalog renamed SKUs (GR-42-pro -> GR42-PRO) and their invoices list the EU entity NimbusEdge GmbH while contract lists NimbusEdge Inc. They need payment cleared to meet a transport window next week. :grimacing:
marketplace-bot: PO 99111 rejected 12 reason: SKU_NOT_FOUND (GR42-PRO)
maria: Which POs? I can look at the ingest logs and finance routing.
sam: 99111, 99112, 99113. 99112 shows billingEntity mismatch flag. Partner is insisting the press brief for joint launch stays on Wed.
zoe: If it's just SKU normalization, we can inject an alias mapping at ingest for the affected SKUs. That would be the fastest.
cal: Billing entity mismatch is trickier. Finance won't pay without legal equivalence for invoices. We could accept to EMEA ledger if partner signs a one-paragraph statement authorizing invoice routing.
meli: @cal FYI the partner's marketplace feed update is blocked by a feed SR awaiting SOW amendment. So they didn't push the new names yet.
sam: They pushed a major ERP catalog migration last month and forgot to sync the marketplace feed. Partner legal says they don't want a full SOW amendment just to fix naming.
zoe: Quick plan: (a) create alias entries GR42-PRO -> GR-42-pro in ingest (b) enable incoming PO acceptance with alias=true (c) require partner brief consent + TAX ID confirmation for billing entity differences. Sound ok?
maria: Legal will need the consent wording. Finance requires TAX ID and evidence that NimbusEdge GmbH can invoice for this account. Otherwise we hold funds.
marketplace-bot: Task created: task-7019 marketplace-ingest-alias + assignee: zoe + due: 2025-01-22T18:00:00Z
zoe: Spinning up alias now. Command: ```curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/ingest/aliases -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"from":"GR42-PRO","to":"GR-42-pro","partner":"NimbusEdge GmbH"}'```
marketplace-bot: Deploy OK: ingest-alias service -> v2.4.1, feature flag marketplace.aliasing=true
sam: Can someone run reprocess for 99111/99113? We need to confirm acceptance before telling partner to ship.
maria: Kicked reprocess job rq-20250121-09
marketplace-bot: Reprocess results: 99111 -> Accepted, 99112 -> Pending (billing_entity_mismatch), 99113 -> Accepted
cal: For 99112 we need a signed consent that allows routing invoices to NimbusEdge GmbH for these POs only, and confirmation of TAX ID DE987654321. Small addendum acceptable.
eli: I can draft a two-line consent. Something like: 'NimbusEdge GmbH authorizes Redwood Inference to accept and process POs under alias mappings for SKUs listed, and consents to invoice routing to NimbusEdge GmbH for the referenced POs. This does not amend other contract terms.'
sam: Awesome. Send to their legal email: legal@nimbusedge.de. Also ask them to sign and attach to PO in portal.
eli: Sent at 16:03 CET. Subject: 'Temporary SKU alias + invoice routing consent'.
marketplace-bot: Partner signed consent uploaded: doc-4432 at 16:18 CET
maria: Finance confirmed TAX ID match and allowed ledger routing. Reprocessing 99112 now.
marketplace-bot: Reprocess complete: 99112 -> Accepted. All three accepted. :tada:
sam: Great. I told partner they can go ahead with shipping 99111/99112/99113. They asked to keep the launch on Wed.
zoe: Let's add this edge case to onboarding: require 'operational invoice entity' field + sku stable id flag in feed. Will open infra PR.
cal: I'll update finance playbook for emergency alias routing and short-consent requirements.
eli: Legal: will add template consent to the legal playbook and tag it for partnerships.
sam: Thanks team. Closing this thread but please link ops playbook entries in the task.
